purpose: Complete a focused task in a labelled modal or explicitly nonmodal surface.
avoid: Avoid nested modals without an explicit focus strategy.
basis: Native source page 73:227 (Dialog), observed anatomy and examples.
profileRationale: The family presents controls or navigation; static depictions do not establish an interactive contract.
sourceRule: modal=true also locks outside pointer interaction and page scroll; modal=false permits the page. trap-focus contains focus without the full modal outside/scroll policy. disablePointerDismissal blocks outside press (and nonmodal focus-out), not the explicit Close control. Popup title/description supply accessible relations.
keyboardAndFocus: Default modal=true contains Tab/Shift+Tab, moves focus into the popup, and restores focus to the trigger on closing. Escape and the supplied close button dismiss unless callback cancellation vetoes. Popup initialFocus/finalFocus may deliberately override the default targets.
referenceDecisions: One stable trigger/content ownership relation per shown instance; concrete labels and task children are caller supplied. Exact wrapper types retain optional handles/payloads/placement overrides. Complete describes this sufficient reference, not a full application/platform certification.
